<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="these-are-worth-looking-at-before-looking-at-style-specific-upgrade-orders"><nowiki>These are worth looking at </nowiki><ins><nowiki>before</nowiki></ins><nowiki> looking at style specific upgrade orders.</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands, </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>other unlocks may be added to this list at any time</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="free-cheap-upgrades"><ins><nowiki>Free &amp; Cheap Upgrades</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Feel free to ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> if unsure where upgrades are relevant for content that you do!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For a checklist version, visit the RS Wiki page at </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order <nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tier-1"><ins><nowiki>Tier 1</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="worth-obtaining-asap-severe-hindrance-to-pvm-without-these"><nowiki>Worth obtaining ASAP - Severe Hindrance to PvM without these</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At least level 90 in your relevant combat style</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ring of Vigour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 50,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can convert into a passive after </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction <nowiki>Extinction</nowiki>]<nowiki> with a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/warped_gem <nowiki>warped gem</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552207824953456.png?v=1" alt="defencemastercape" title="defencemastercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Defence 99 cape - provides a sign of life once per hour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Level 95 Prayer and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Temple_at_Senntisten <nowiki>The Temple at Senntisten</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Level 99 Herblore </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can boost from 99 to make Elder Overloads with the aid of pulse cores, and can request assistance to make </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><ins><nowiki>Style Specific:</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , Death's Swiftness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These both come from the world wakes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Style-specific Skillcapes - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 99,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Strength (99) - extend Dismember </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1" alt="dismember" title="dismember" kind="icon" /><nowiki> duration</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Attack (120) - +2% increased hit chance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ranged (99) - +20% ammo special effect procs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee &quot;utility&quot; specs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon battleaxe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="dba" title="dba" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 115,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon scimitar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1" alt="dragonscimitar" title="dragonscimitar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 125,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tier-2"><ins><nowiki>Tier 2</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="work-towards-these-after-finishing-tier-1-unlocks"><nowiki>Work towards these after finishing tier 1 unlocks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Entry Level Perks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1088041624803745862.png?v=1" alt="ancientweapongizmo" title="ancientweapongizmo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697405383769194516.png?v=1" alt="ancientarmourgizmo" title="ancientarmourgizmo" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Refer to </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> for setups as well as cost</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Berserker's Fury </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1" alt="berserkersfury" title="berserkersfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (56 Archaeology </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 112 Archaeology </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/941211288665739274.png?v=1" alt="archaeology" title="archaeology" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (refer to </nowiki><code><nowiki>!relic</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for setups)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Will need to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450653390360626.png?v=1" alt="pulsecore" title="pulsecore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> boosts to unlock 650 energy and certain relics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Claim the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Codex_Ultimatus <nowiki>Codex Ultimatus</nowiki>]<nowiki> to unlock </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Totem of Vitality </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1" alt="vitalitytotem" title="vitalitytotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (85 Agility, 90 Slayer)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 120 combat stats (refer to </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span><nowiki> for methods)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tier-3"><ins><nowiki>Tier 3</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="get-these-when-you-can"><nowiki>Get these when you can</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Summoning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, notable milestones are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 45 for Hellhound </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 73 for Blood Reaver </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1" alt="reaverpouch" title="reaverpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 87 for Nihils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1" alt="shadownihil" title="shadownihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1" alt="smokenihil" title="smokenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1" alt="icenihil" title="icenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1" alt="bloodnihil" title="bloodnihil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 90 for Kal'gerion Demon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 96 for Ripper Demon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><code><nowiki>!familiar</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎to see where to use what familiar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Asylum Surgeon's Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158472839208.png?v=1" alt="asr" title="asr" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is a good all round ring for all styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zorgoth's Soul Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1232124265826877574.png?v=1" alt="zorgothsring" title="zorgothsring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> only)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="other"><ins><nowiki>Other</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="as-soon-as-you-are-able-to-get-these-get-them"><nowiki>As soon as you are able to get these, get them.</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zuk Capes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmej" title="igneouskalmej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmor" title="igneouskalmor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalzuk" title="igneouskalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalket" title="igneouskalket" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can kill Zuk 4 times in one style to get all the capes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is usually recommended around t85 gear</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The hardmode cape is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> needed, and is mainly a quality of life upgrade</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
